reason: Our customer terms already put agent risk on the customer, and nobody, not FINRA, not our board, not our customers, is asking me for an agent gate yet. I like being first and I'd take a demo, but I'm not signing up when I don't feel the pain.
objection: This would put an unaudited startup with zero customers inline on every customer trade. If it goes down, orders stop, and I'd lose that vendor-risk review before the pilot even started. Free for six months doesn't help if I also have to give you an LOI with a price and a public reference.
would_change_my_mind: A regulator saying our terms don't cover us, meaning FINRA or SEC guidance or an exam finding that holds the broker responsible for supervising customer agents, or a real agent incident on our MCP server.
